label: Cheer
notes: Procedural cheer tuned from CMU 05_12 inspiration: idle ease-in, front-readable planted stance, anticipation dip, small bounce, wide overhead V with straight elbows, two fist-pump bounces, and idle settle. Uses facing 0 during the peak because the shipping renderer scales front-view lateral offsets by (1 - |facing|); facing 0.8-1.0 collapses the V in this engine.
